snippet.title: TRON: Catalyst - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
\RUN
\TRON_CATALYST

Collapse is imminent. Harness the Glitch. Fight for the Grid.
From Disney and Pixar Games / Bithell Games, Big Fan is proud to present TRON: Catalyst.

TRON: Catalyst is OUT NOW on PC/Mac, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch.

Buy Now: https://www.bigfangames.com/games/tron-catalyst
